scene.speaker: nico
scene.bubble: Animal talents! Birds can fly, fish can swim, monkeys can climb… and Pip can do almost everything!
scene.intro: Animal talents! Birds can fly high over the sea. Fish can swim, and they never get tired. Monkeys can climb the tallest trees, dogs can run very fast, and cats can sleep for hours and hours. Nico wants to know: can a puffin sing? Pip opens his beak… and everybody covers their ears! What can animals do? Come and find out with Nico and Pip!

activities.title: Listen to the talent quiz. Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Nico: Animal quiz! Can a fish fly? … Astrid: No, it can't! But it can swim. … Nico: Can a monkey climb? … Astrid: Yes, it can! Very high! … Nico: Can an elephant jump? … Astrid: No! Elephants can't jump. True fact! … Nico: Can Pip swim AND fly? … Astrid: Yes, he can! Puffins are amazing. … Nico: Winner: Astrid, four out of four!

activities.title: A and B are not the same. Find out why!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 11 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Choose 3 animals. For each, write one can and one can't: A duck can swim but it can't climb.

outcomes.puede: Follow classroom instructions; identify familiar words in songs and short spoken sentences.
Greet; say name, age, colours; name objects; answer yes/no questions.
Recognise all 26 letters; match words to pictures (family, food, animals, body).
Write own name; trace and copy words; label pictures (3–5 words).
~150 productive words; Verb to be, can, like + noun, imperatives, this/that.
